messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate and cross-region latency spike observed for customer requests routed from eu-west to us-east. 5xx rate up ~12% for the last 3m, latency p95 eu-west->us-east jumps to 2.7s. Auto-failover did not trigger. Paging oncall.

sre-oncall-jen: I'm on it. grabbing logs + starting runbook checks. @netops-maya can you confirm if any recent routing policy change was pushed? :eyes:

netops-maya: No intentional policy pushes in the last 24h from my side. I see a flurry of route updates from the geo-operator service around 1759876420 that correlate with the window. Investigating.

platform-jordan: I'm seeing amplified DNS TTL churn for eu-west probe set, TTLs dropping from 60->5s then back. Might be a DNS cache invalidation loop. Could be related to the geo-agent retrying on failures.

sre-oncall-jen: Good catch. Checking service mesh telemetry — it shows many clients getting 421 or ECONNRESET when preferring us-east. Traffic that should be handled in eu-west is being routed inter-region for ~30-60s bursts.

eng-runtime-vasu: Putting together quick check: kernel-level conntrack + LB logs show repeated client IPs being rewritten to us-east backends. Suspect region pinning dropped for a subset of backends after an agent rollout.

support-alex: We have 3 customers reporting increased latencies and a few 5xx errors in the last 10m. Sending heads-up to affected accounts with a short note.

sre-oncall-jen: Runbook actions: 1) disable geo-agent rollout (if live) 2) pin routing policy to eu-west-only for high-risk prefixes 3) increase caching TTL to 120s to avoid excessive flapping 4) collect pcap/flow if needed. Executing step 1 now.

netops-maya: Disabled the recent geo-agent rollout at 1759876488. Rolling back agent config to revision r2024-11-02. Observability: route update churn dropping but still seeing misdirects in recent requests.

sre-oncall-jen: We'll apply temporary pin for eu-west for traffic matching prefix set 'prod-eu-critical'. Command I'm running:

```
# pin routes to eu-west for critical prefixes
redwood-routing set-policy --prefix-set prod-eu-critical --preferred-region eu-west --force --reason "mitigation: pin after cross-region misroute"
```

sre-oncall-jen: Done at 1759876520. Monitoring.

platform-jordan: After pin, error rate dropped from 12% -> 2.1% in the pinned prefixes. Latency p95 for pinned flows down to 220ms. Non-pinned flows still seeing occasional spikes.

eng-runtime-vasu: Noticed that KV cache invalidation in the runtime had an aggressive fallback that downgraded region affinity if KV lookup timed out. I suspect a bug where a timeout threshold was too low and caused affinity flips under transient latency. Investigating code path now.

netops-maya: Also seeing DNS responses with inconsistent region hints (X-Geo-Region) due to some probes hitting a stale edge with a different cache. Working on isolating the edge node and draining it.

sre-oncall-jen: OK, start draining suspect edge node: edge-eu-17. Command:

```
edgectl drain edge-eu-17 --grace 30s --reason "suspect stale cache causing region hints"
```

netops-maya: drain started at 1759876590. telemetry shows fewer inconsistent region hints after drain.

support-alex: Customer update posted: "We detected increased latency and errors affecting a subset of EU requests. We've applied a temporary routing pin to serve traffic from eu-west while we investigate. Will follow up with a post-incident summary." :email:

sre-oncall-jen: Oncall handoff note: if this persists after my shift, please pick up with the pinned prefixes in place and follow the mitigation playbook. I will create a SEV doc after stabilizing.

eng-runtime-vasu: Found the issue: the runtime fallback sets affinity to 'best-effort' after a 150ms KV timeout; a recent change decreased timeout from 500ms to 150ms. Pushing hotfix to restore to 500ms for the affinity path. Preparing patch now.

platform-jordan: Patch looks good in staging. Ready to promote to canary. Recommend canary to 10% of runtime pods in eu-west, monitor for reappearance of flips.

sre-oncall-jen: Approving canary rollout. Keep the routing pin in place until we confirm stable for 30m. Also note: do not change DNS TTLs while we observe; we'll revert TTL to standard after 15m observation window.

netops-maya: Canary promoted at 1759876675 to 10% pods. I will keep an eye on route churn metrics.

sre-oncall-jen: Update 1759876701: error rate and p95 stable for pinned prefixes. Non-pinned flows improving. Keeping pins for now. Next steps: 1) fully roll patch if canary stable for 30m 2) open SEV-1 ticket with timeline and customer impact 3) postmortem to include fix + test to prevent KV timeout regressions.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-582 with severity = SEV-1, assignees = [sre-oncall-jen, eng-runtime-vasu, netops-maya].

sre-oncall-jen: Thanks all. If anything changes I'll reopen thread. Otherwise I'll draft the postmortem and prefix list for rollback safety. :thumbsup:
